colly.note: Go scraping library; ignores robots.txt by default

anthropic-ai.note: Retired Anthropic name. Harmless, but has no effect

claude-web.note: Retired Anthropic name. Harmless, but has no effect

facebookbot.note: No longer in Meta’s crawler documentation

google-notebooklm.note: Former name of Google-GeminiNotebook, supported until August 2026

chatglm-spider.note: Older name from community lists; Z.ai’s training summary names GLMBot

aliyunbot.note: Name from community lists, not confirmed by Alibaba

erniebot.note: Name from community lists, not confirmed by Baidu

yiyanbot.note: Name from community lists, not confirmed by Baidu

grokbot.note: Name from community lists; xAI publishes no crawler names

xai-grok.note: Name from community lists; xAI publishes no crawler names

xai-searchbot.note: Name from community lists; xAI publishes no crawler names

grok-deepsearch.note: Name from community lists; xAI publishes no crawler names

grok-agent.note: Name from community lists; xAI publishes no crawler names

deepseekbot.note: Name from community lists; DeepSeek publishes no crawler documentation

coherebot.note: Cohere’s own robots.txt name. Cohere says it doesn’t currently crawl to train models

cohere-ai.note: Not in Cohere’s documentation, which uses Coherebot

cohere-training-data-crawler.note: Not in Cohere’s documentation, which uses Coherebot

imagesiftbot.note: Hive’s image search index; training not mentioned. If not named, it follows your Googlebot rules

firecrawlagent.note: Firecrawl: multi-page crawls check robots.txt; single-page scrapes don’t

trafilatura.note: Its crawler checks robots.txt; single downloads don’t

scrapy.note: Checks robots.txt only in projects made from its template

googlebot-image.note: Google Images and Discover. Not a training control

googleother.note: Google’s general crawler for product teams, not Search

googleother-image.note: Google’s general crawler for images, not Search

googleother-video.note: Google’s general crawler for video, not Search

__usage_ai-training.note: Shared AI-training preference from an individual IETF draft. Anthropic applies it when ClaudeBot isn’t named; Google (when Google-Extended isn’t named) and Microsoft plan to from early 2027

operator.note: OpenAI’s agent identifies itself with signed request headers (Signature-Agent: https://chatgpt.com) and a normal browser user agent, so this rule likely matches nothing

mistralai-crawler.note: Not a Mistral name. Mistral documents MistralAI-Training, MistralAI-Index and MistralAI-User

deepseek.note: DeepSeek publishes no crawler names; this rule likely matches nothing

deepseek-crawler.note: DeepSeek publishes no crawler names; this rule likely matches nothing

deepseek-v3.note: A model name, not a crawler; this rule likely matches nothing

webzio.note: Not a documented Webz.io name; its crawler is omgili, its training control Webzio-Extended

omgilibot.note: Old Webz.io name; omgili is the current crawler

laiondownloader.note: LAION says it doesn’t crawl: its datasets list image URLs from Common Crawl, downloaded with tools such as img2dataset

ai2bot-dolma.note: Not on Ai2’s crawler page, which names only AI2Bot

tiktokspider.note: ByteDance fetcher; purpose and robots.txt behaviour not documented

diffbot.note: Builds a web knowledge graph sold for AI and data uses; community lists say robots.txt compliance is up to its customers

brightbot.note: Bright Data; community lists report AI-training use and disguised requests

isscybercrawler.note: ISS cyber-risk models; community lists report it ignores robots.txt

isscyberriskcrawler.note: ISS cyber-risk models; community lists report it ignores robots.txt

aihitbot.note: aiHit company-data crawler (community lists); aiHit’s site doesn’t document it

cotoyogi.note: ROIS-DS (Japan) crawler collecting Japanese-language data. Community lists call it an AI scraper; ROIS doesn’t say so

crawlspace.note: Crawlspace platform where developers run crawlers for apps, AI agents and RAG. Blocking it blocks them all

factset_spyderbot.note: FactSet data collection for AI (community lists)

friendlycrawler.note: Unknown operator building machine-learning datasets (community lists)

icc-crawler.note: NICT (Japan) crawler for research including AI; data may be shared with companies and other third parties

kangaroo.note: Kangaroo LLM: Australian content for its training dataset. Its website is now offline (archived page linked)

qualifiedbot.note: Qualified crawls its customers’ websites to power its AI sales products. Its page doesn’t mention robots.txt

sidetrade.note: Sidetrade indexer: data for products including AI training (community lists)

timpibot.note: Timpi: data offered for AI model training (community lists)

velenpublicwebcrawler.note: Velen crawler for Hunter, building business datasets and machine-learning models

wpbot.note: Community lists link it to a WordPress AI chatbot plugin, but its opt-out form was made at Plesk. Undocumented

semrushbot-ocob.note: Semrush ContentShake AI tool, fetching pages for AI-written content

semrushbot-swa.note: Semrush SEO Writing Assistant, checking pages for its AI writing tool

mediapartners-google.note: Google AdSense. Blocking it affects ad targeting, not Search or AI

peer39_crawler.note: Peer39 contextual ad targeting and brand safety

peer_39_crawler.note: Peer39 contextual ad targeting and brand safety

admantx.note: Contextual ad targeting and brand safety

landau-media-spider.note: Name from community lists; its user agent links to landaumedia.de (Landau Media, a German media-monitoring firm). Purpose not documented

um-ln.note: Name from community lists, said to be UNICEPTA (formerly Ubermetrics) media monitoring (Germany). Not confirmed by UNICEPTA

um-ic.note: Name from community lists, said to be UNICEPTA (formerly Ubermetrics) media monitoring (Germany). Not confirmed by UNICEPTA

um-fc.note: Name from community lists, said to be UNICEPTA (formerly Ubermetrics) media monitoring (Germany). Not confirmed by UNICEPTA

pmgcrawler.note: Name from community lists, said to be PMG Presse-Monitor press clipping (Germany). Not confirmed by PMG

echobot.note: Name from community lists, which attribute it to Echobox (UK social publishing), not the German Echobot (now Dealfront). Not confirmed by either

news-please.note: Open-source news crawler library; behaviour depends on who runs it

imgproxy.note: Image-resizing server software. Its requests come from whoever runs it, usually fetching images to resize

baiduspider.note: Baidu search (China); also supplies Baidu’s ERNIE

sistrix.note: SISTRIX SEO toolbox crawler. Its user agent says “SISTRIX Crawler”

seobility.note: Seobility SEO audit crawler (Germany); Seobility also accepts this name

audisto.note: Audisto SEO crawler for verified sites (Germany)

audisto-essential.note: Audisto SEO crawler that can crawl any site (Germany)

searchmetricsbot.note: Searchmetrics SEO crawler, now run by Conductor

rytebot.note: Ryte website-quality tools crawler (formerly OnPage.org), now documented by Semrush

semrushbot-si.note: Semrush On Page SEO Checker crawler

splitsignalbot.note: Semrush SplitSignal SEO A/B testing crawler

ahrefssiteaudit.note: Ahrefs Site Audit crawler. Site owners can ask Ahrefs to make it ignore robots.txt on their own sites

barkrowler.note: Babbar link-graph crawler for SEO tools

sebot-wa.note: SE Ranking Website Audit crawler. Users can switch off robots.txt

screaming.note: Screaming Frog desktop SEO crawler, run by its users. Users can switch off robots.txt

sitebulb.note: Sitebulb website audit crawler, run by its users. Users can switch off robots.txt

botify.note: Botify SEO crawler. If not named, it follows your Googlebot rules

deepcrawl.note: Former name of Lumar’s SEO crawler; Lumar still honours it

siteimprovebot.note: Siteimprove quality, SEO and accessibility crawler. Its user agent says SiteCheck-sitecrawl

siteimprovebot-crawler.note: Siteimprove quality, SEO and accessibility crawler (alternative name)

uptimerobot.note: UptimeRobot uptime checks of URLs the site owner sets up. Monitors like this usually don’t read robots.txt

statuscake.note: StatusCake uptime checks of URLs the site owner sets up. Monitors like this usually don’t read robots.txt

better.note: Better Stack uptime checks of URLs the site owner sets up. Monitors like this usually don’t read robots.txt

kagibot.note: Kagi search. If not named, it follows your Googlebot rules

coccocbot.note: Coc Coc search (Vietnam); covers all Coc Coc robots

coccocbot-web.note: Coc Coc search (Vietnam), main web crawler

slurp.note: Yahoo Search; also collects partner content for Yahoo News, Finance and Sports

adsbot-google.note: Google Ads landing-page quality checks. Ignores * rules, so it must be named to be blocked

adsbot-google-mobile.note: Google Ads mobile landing-page checks. Ignores * rules, so it must be named to be blocked

adsbot-google-mobile-apps.note: Retired Google Ads crawler for Android app pages. Harmless, but has no effect

duplexweb-google.note: Retired crawler for Google’s Duplex on the web. Harmless, but has no effect

googleweblight.note: Retired Google Web Light. Harmless, but has no effect

storebot-google.note: Google Shopping crawler. Not Search ranking, not AI

google-inspectiontool.note: Google Search testing tools, such as URL Inspection and the Rich Results Test

googlebot-video.note: Video features in Google Search. Not a training control

googlebot-news.note: Google News. A robots.txt name only: the fetching is done by Googlebot

slackbot-linkexpanding.note: Slack link previews. Slack says it doesn’t honour robots.txt

slackbot.note: Slack’s general-purpose fetcher. Slack says it doesn’t honour robots.txt

slack-imgproxy.note: Slack image proxy for images posted in Slack

pinterestbot.note: Pinterest crawler for Pin content and product details

trendictionbot.note: Trendiction (Talkwalker’s company, Luxembourg) media and market data crawler

mediamonitoringbot.note: Media monitoring of Ukrainian online media

pressenginebot.note: PressEngine coverage tracking for video-game PR. PressEngine says it doesn’t follow robots.txt

archive.org_bot.note: Internet Archive and Archive-It. Follows robots.txt by default; Archive-It customers can override it

bnf.fr_bot.note: French National Library web archive. As a legal-deposit crawler it is allowed to disregard robots.txt

bl.uk_lddc_bot.note: UK Web Archive legal-deposit crawler. Generally follows robots.txt, but may overrule it

arquivo-web-crawler.note: Arquivo.pt, the Portuguese national web archive

nlux_iaharvester.note: National Library of Luxembourg web archive

nlnbot.note: National Library of Norway web archive

feedly.note: Feedly RSS reader’s feed fetcher. Feedly says it doesn’t follow robots.txt

inoreader.note: Inoreader RSS reader’s feed fetcher. Inoreader says it doesn’t read robots.txt

feedfetcher-google.note: Google’s RSS and Atom fetcher for Google News and WebSub. Google says it ignores robots.txt

flipboardproxy.note: Flipboard fetching pages for the Flipboard app

at-bot.note: nic.at (.at domain registry) start-page fetcher, Austria

cert.at-crawler.note: CERT.at security crawler of .at start pages, Austria

searchEngines.Googlebot: Also removes this site from Google Search
searchEngines.Bingbot: Also removes this site from Bing and Copilot answers
searchEngines.Applebot: Also removes this site from Siri and Spotlight suggestions
